description: ADR-080 sidecar manifest. Each entry justifies one versioned agent model pin with a committed sweep artifact. Skills and commands may never appear here (they cannot be swept). Fields per entry: unit (repo-relative path), model (versioned id the pin uses), decision (must be KEEP_PIN), artifact (repo-relative sweep JSON path), fixtures_sha, default_model (the harness default the sweep compared against), date (YYYY-MM-DD the sweep ran). Evidence older than 180 days is stale. Empty, and empty is the expected steady state after the 2026-09-05 migration (issue #5605): that migration removed every remaining agent pin rather than sweeping for one, because all of them were bare sonnet or opus aliases and rule 3 forbids minting a versioned id from those two, so no sweep verdict could have produced a compliant kept pin. An entry appears here only when someone wants to ADD a versioned agent pin and has the KEEP_PIN sweep to justify it.
